evidence.source: Ministry of Education, Taiwan, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.field: 氣 entry: Shuowen analysis and sense history
evidence.text: The entry gives Shuowen’s analysis of 氣 as fodder and grain supplied to a guest, formed from 米 with 气 as phonetic, and quotes 春秋傳: 齊人來氣諸侯. It reports that the grain-provision graph was later written 餼, while 氣 was borrowed for the cloud-vapor word. This is a lexicographic account, not a dated account of when those changes occurred.
evidence.title: A02115 氣 - Ministry of Education《Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants》2024

evidence.source: 清初王育《許氏說文解字六書論正》溯源古文字形之商兌
evidence.field: 气: reported early forms and interpretation of graphic continuity
evidence.text: The article reports oracle-bone examples 合10925 and 合9461, bronze examples 天亡簋 and 洹子孟姜壺, and the Shuowen small-seal form. It follows a cloud-vapor interpretation, but its account depends on a traditional reading of the forms and does not settle the disputed oracle-bone referent.
evidence.title: 清初王育《許氏說文解字六書論正》溯源古文字形之商兌

evidence.field: glyph style, source specimen and provenance
evidence.text: The exact Commons page describes the file as a modern vector rendering of 气 in Shang oracle-script style and links it to Sinica record 41.E23A, specimen 前7.36.2 合12532. It is a redrawing, not an artifact photograph. The page states CC0 terms for the source glyph image.

evidence.text: The exact page identifies a modern vector rendering of 氣 in Shuowen seal-script style and states public-domain/CC0 terms, including a link to the Xiaoxuetang rights notice. This is a digital redrawing of a historical script form, not an artifact photograph.

gaps: The earliest oracle-bone referent for 气 remains disputed; this pass found a traditional cloud-vapor interpretation, but it does not independently establish that the graph depicts vapor.
The accessible sources do not establish a dated semantic sequence for breath, air, cloud vapor, and the grain-provision word, or dates for the textual layers quoted by the dictionaries.
No independent early pronunciation for a depicted object was established, so no borrowing claim that depends on an original object's name is made.
The exact official Unihan pages for U+6C14 and U+6C23 failed to open. Supplied local rows report kMandarin qì for both, but are not represented as externally inspected Unicode records.

The image candidates supplied in acquisition_findings returned 404 and are unavailable for this run. This search verified the different Commons file 氣-seal.svg, but its original SVG URL was not verified from the file-description page; no direct image candidate is returned.
The supplied local Baxter–Sagart readings were not re-queried from the repository during this invocation, so no new phonological comparison is asserted.

limitations.text: The supplied direct image candidates for 气-oracle.svg and 氣-seal.svg returned 404 and cannot be reused in this run. An alternate Commons description page for 氣-seal.svg is accessible and documents a modern redrawing and CC0/public-domain terms, but the direct image URL was not verified from that page in this pass. No image is returned.
